will be an evil final return

38:56.text: Hell! Where they will burn, and worst

38:57.text: This is so! Then let them taste it - a boiling fluid and dirty wound discharges.

38:59.text: This is a troop entering with you
, no welcome for them! Verily, they shall burn in the Fire!

38:60.text: (The followers of the misleaders will say)
! No welcome for you! It is you
(because you misled us in the world)
, so evil is this place to stay in!"

38:61.text: They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to him a double torment in the Fire!"
